description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView component that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface, formatted with log level, tags, messages, and exceptions.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs formatted log messages received via the LogNode interface.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the LogView with different parameter sets.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and displays a log message, including priority, tag, message, and throwable details, on the LogView.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView.
